the framework presented in this paper is an efficient and effective means for modeling and querying the location and movement of mobile users and stationary objects of interests in a road network.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a framework to model road network constrained mobile users, which is based on a graph representation of road network, a two-dimensional representation of road network and a two-dimensional representation for mobile users.
we develop a data model for location-based services that is suitable for a wide range of applications and that is amenable to efficient querying.
the proposed framework enables the efficient processing of queries for moving objects in the context of a transportation network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the two supplementary representations of the road network are complementary and that the graph representation is the more efficient of the two.

the graph representation, which is more general than its two-dimensional counterpart, is more suitable for the development of location-based services that require the use of network-constrained moving object data.
, for the problem at hand, a graph representation is more appropriate than a traditional two-dimensional road network representation.
